hero.heading: 🚀 Blast off!
hero.body: Welcome to Planet Hop! Buckle up — we're going on the biggest adventure ever. We're flying all the way through our solar system, visiting every single planet! Are you ready? Let's go! 🌟
hero.subtitle: Hop from Mercury to Neptune and discover mind-blowing facts about every planet in our cosmic neighbourhood.

planets.heading: Meet the 8 Planets! 🪐
planets.body: Our solar system has eight amazing planets. Each one is totally different and super cool. Scroll down to meet them all!
planets.title: Your Planetary Pit Stops
planets.subtitle: Every planet in our solar system has something jaw-dropping to offer. Tap a card to learn more about each world.

planetsList.name: Mercury
planetsList.fact: Mercury has no air at all, so it gets super hot in the day (430°C!) and freezing cold at night (-180°C!) — all in one day!

planetsList.name: Venus
planetsList.fact: Venus spins backwards compared to most planets, so the Sun rises in the west there — how weird is that?!

planetsList.name: Earth
planetsList.fact: Earth is the only planet we know of that has living things on it — including YOU! Pretty special, right?

planetsList.name: Mars
planetsList.fact: Mars has the tallest volcano in the whole solar system — Olympus Mons is three times taller than Mount Everest!

planetsList.name: Jupiter
planetsList.fact: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm that has been spinning for over 350 years — it's bigger than the whole Earth!

planetsList.name: Saturn
planetsList.fact: Saturn's rings are made of billions of chunks of ice and rock, and they stretch out 282,000 km — but they're super thin, like a piece of paper!

planetsList.name: Uranus
planetsList.fact: Uranus spins on its side, like a rolling ball! Scientists think a giant rock crashed into it a long, long time ago.

planetsList.name: Neptune
planetsList.fact: Neptune has the strongest winds in the solar system — they blow faster than 2,000 km per hour! That's way faster than any storm on Earth!

vote.heading: Pick your favourite planet! 🗳️
vote.body: Which planet is your favourite? Tap the button next to your pick and see which planet everyone loves the most! My favourite is Saturn because the rings look so cool. What's yours? 😄
vote.title: Pick Your Favourite Planet
vote.subtitle: If you could visit any planet in the solar system, which one would you choose? Cast your vote below!

footer.heading: Thanks for hopping with me! 🚀
footer.body: I hope you loved learning about all the planets as much as I do! Space is the most amazing thing ever. Keep looking up at the stars — the universe is waiting for you! 🌌✨
items: Made with 💜 by a kid who really loves space
All planet facts are real — go check them out in a space book!

trip.title: How Long Would the Trip Take?
trip.subtitle: Travelling at the speed of a space shuttle (28,000 km/h), here is how long it would take to reach each planet from Earth.
trip.funNote: Fun fact: the New Horizons probe, the fastest spacecraft ever launched, still took 9.5 years to reach Pluto. Space is really, really big!

cta.title: Ready to Explore the Universe?
cta.subtitle: Scroll back up and take another look at the planets. There is always something new to discover out there.
